exact_statement: For every fixed K>16/5 and epsilon>0, FEI(K) on finite uniform Boolean functions that have full affine Fourier span, minimize influence over their full affine spectral orbit, have I<epsilon, and have an original proper physical pair paid at K by an executable non-character linear reset implies full FEI(K) at the SAME K; the converse is immediate. More explicitly, for any positive-entropy seed f choose an affine-minimal compressed g with H(g)=H(f), q=I(g)<=I(f), mu=Eg with abs(mu)<1. Let Q=(-1)^(ab+ac+bc+za), G_t=Q times t disjoint copies of g, k=max(2,ceil(sqrt(t))), p=2^-k, and F=1+1[controls=0](G_t-1). F is full-span affine minimal; I=p[tq+2+k(1-mu^t/4)] tends to0 and H(F)/I(F) tends to H(g)/q. Query original pair(a,b) and shear only the character-weight-two branch, with all four terminals retained: I_pair=p, expected reset release=p/4, and abs(L_pair/p-4)<=(13+6k)abs(mu)^t, hence the explicit pair price tends to16/5 and is eventually strictly paid at K. Character-only child release is zero. If H(g)-Kq>0, all four complete reset terminals and their full-affine optima still violate K for sufficiently large t; the exact same-bank identity D_K(F)+S_pair^reset=L_pair-5Kp/4 gives a negative inherited bank. The eight-bit point defect with t100000000,k10000,K15/4 gives exact paid margin/p>7633553/12500016 and all four terminal deficits/p>862405/4, certified without evaluating its large truth table.
